hook: Most professional fund managers lose to a simple index fund over the long run. In this video I explain index funds from three angles: the numbers (fees, diversification, why the pros lose and Buffett's million dollar bet), the psychology that makes boring investing so hard, and a step by step playbook to start in one afternoon.
